<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<link rel="icon" href="data:,">
<title>Little Bloom Kit — Paint, Create, Bloom!</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@600;700;800&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<noscript><style>.reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}</style></noscript>
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#3D235E; --purple:#4A2C6B; --dim:#6F5F92;
  --pink:#FF5D8F; --pink-soft:#FFF0F6; --lav:#F3EFFF; --sky:#EAF6FF;
  --peach:#FFF4E6; --mint:#EAF9F0; --sun:#FFFBEB; --white:#ffffff;
  --line:#EFE6FF;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:#FFF9FC;color:var(--ink);font-family:"Nunito",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.6}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
button{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
::selection{background:#FFE066;color:var(--purple)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;color:var(--purple);line-height:1.12;font-weight:800}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
section{padding:72px 0}
.section-head{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:36px}
.section-head.center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,50px);margin-bottom:12px}
.section-head p{color:var(--dim);font-size:17px}
.photo{border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.btn{display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid transparent;min-height:54px}
.btn-primary{background:var(--pink);color:#fff}
.btn-secondary{background:#fff;color:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple)}
.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.04)}

/* gentle reveal only */
@keyframes floatSoft{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
@keyframes marquee{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* HERO — clean two-column, nothing overlaps the photo */
.hero{background:var(--pink-soft);padding:40px 0 64px}
.hero-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:40px}
.hero-top .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;color:var(--purple);font-size:19px}
.hero-top .brand img{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover}
.hero-top nav{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-top nav a{color:var(--purple);text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.02fr .98fr;gap:52px;align-items:center}
.hero-text h1{font-size:clamp(46px,6.5vw,76px);margin-bottom:14px}
.hero-text .tagline{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:clamp(21px,3vw,28px);color:var(--pink);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero-text p{color:var(--dim);font-size:18px;max-width:480px;margin-bottom:28px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero-photo{border-radius:28px;border:8px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(74,44,107,.14);overflow:hidden;animation:floatSoft 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;aspect-ratio:4/3.4}
@media(max-width:820px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}}

/* one simple strip */
.strip{overflow:hidden;background:#FFE066;padding:10px 0}
.strip .track{display:flex;width:max-content;white-space:nowrap;animation:marquee 30s linear infinite;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--purple);text-transform:uppercase}
.strip .track span{padding:0 18px}

/* INTRO */
.intro-sec{background:#fff}
.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 44px;margin-top:28px}
.stats div strong{display:block;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:30px;color:var(--purple)}
.stats div span{color:var(--dim);font-size:15px}

/* PICKS */
.picks-sec{background:var(--lav)}
.picks-sec .photo img{aspect-ratio:16/8}
.picks-list{margin-top:22px;color:var(--dim);font-size:16px;text-align:center}
.picks-list b{color:var(--purple)}

/* KITS — photo and text side by side, never overlapping */
.kits-sec{background:#fff;padding-bottom:32px}
.kit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;padding:40px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.kit:first-of-type{border-top:none}
.kit .photo img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.kit.flip .kit-photo{order:2}
.kit-no{font-weight:800;color:var(--pink);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.kit h3{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,44px);margin-bottom:12px}
.kit p{color:var(--dim);font-size:17px;margin-bottom:14px;max-width:460px}
.kit-tags{font-weight:800;color:var(--purple);font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:820px){.kit{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px}.kit.flip .kit-photo{order:0}}

/* PLAY ZONE — clean rows */
.playzone{background:var(--sky)}
.pz-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.pz-stars{background:#FFE066;color:var(--purple);font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.pz-sub{color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:28px}
#gameRows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.gamerow{width:100%;border:2px solid var(--line);background:#fff;text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:18px;color:var(--ink);transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s}
.gamerow:hover{border-color:#FFB6D9}
.gamerow:active{transform:scale(.995)}
.gamerow .num{font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:var(--pink);min-width:30px}
.gamerow .gname{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(20px,3.4vw,28px);color:var(--purple);flex:1;line-height:1.15}
.gamerow .gdesc{font-size:14px;color:var(--dim);max-width:230px;line-height:1.45}
.gamerow .playword{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;background:var(--pink);color:#fff;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:640px){.gamerow .gdesc{display:none}.gamerow{padding:16px 14px;gap:10px}}

/* game overlay (unchanged behaviour, clean chrome) */
#gameOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:#FFF7FB;color:var(--ink);display:none;flex-direction:column}
#gameOverlay.open{display:flex}
.go-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;background:#FFD6E8}
.go-top h3{font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,30px);flex:1}
.go-close{background:var(--purple);color:#fff;border:none;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;font-size:28px;font-weight:800;flex:none}
.go-score{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;background:#FFE066;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:17px;white-space:nowrap}
#gameBody{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px 16px 30px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.go-foot{padding:12px 16px;background:var(--lav);display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.go-again{background:var(--pink);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;padding:14px 30px;border-radius:999px;min-height:56px}
.g-inst{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,26px);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--purple)}
.g-msg{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;min-height:32px;margin:12px 0;color:var(--pink)}
.g-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;justify-content:center;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.g-opt{background:#fff;border:4px solid #CDB4F0;border-radius:24px;min-width:84px;min-height:84px;font-size:44px;padding:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;color:var(--purple)}
.g-opt:active{transform:scale(.93)}
.g-opt.good{border-color:#58CC7A;background:#DFF7E6}
.g-opt.bad{border-color:#FF6B6B;background:#FFE1E1}
.g-col{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;border:5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2);cursor:pointer}
.g-big{font-size:clamp(70px,18vw,120px);line-height:1.2}
.g-word{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:clamp(28px,7vw,44px);font-weight:800}
.memgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto}
.memcard{aspect-ratio:1;border:none;border-radius:20px;background:#CDB4F0;font-size:38px;cursor:pointer}
.memcard.open{background:#fff;border:4px solid #FFB6D9}
.catchbox{position:relative;height:340px;background:linear-gradient(#DFF3FF,#FFF0F6);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}
.basket{position:absolute;bottom:6px;font-size:52px;transition:left .15s;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.faller{position:absolute;font-size:40px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.arrowrow{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.arrowbtn{background:var(--purple);color:#fff;border:none;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;font-size:28px}
.popitem{position:absolute;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:46px;cursor:pointer}
.holegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;max-width:360px;margin:0 auto}
.hole{height:96px;border-radius:50%;background:#B5EAD7;border:none;font-size:50px;cursor:pointer}
.ttt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,92px);gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.ttt button{height:92px;font-size:52px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;border:4px solid #A8D8EA;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;color:var(--purple)}
.simon{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;max-width:320px;margin:0 auto}
.simon button{height:120px;border:none;border-radius:28px;opacity:.55;cursor:pointer}
.simon button.lit{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05)}
.mazegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,58px);gap:6px;justify-content:center}
.mazecell{height:58px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:32px}
.mazecell.wall{background:#CDB4F0}
.diffscene{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.diffbox{background:#fff;border:4px solid #FFC8A2;border-radius:20px;padding:14px;font-size:38px;line-height:1.5;max-width:250px}
.diffbox button{background:none;border:none;font-size:38px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px}
.puzgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,88px);gap:8px;justify-content:center}
.puzgrid button{height:88px;border:none;border-radius:18px;background:#FFB6D9;font-size:40px;cursor:pointer}
.puzgrid button.empty{background:var(--lav)}
#drawCanvas{background:#fff;border:4px solid #CDB4F0;border-radius:20px;touch-action:none;max-width:100%}
.stampfall{position:absolute;font-size:34px;pointer-events:none;animation:fallEmoji 1.6s linear forwards}
@keyframes fallEmoji{to{transform:translateY(90vh) rotate(200deg);opacity:0}}

/* BIRTHDAYS — poster lives here only */
.birthdays{background:var(--pink-soft)}
.bday-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.bday-grid .photo img{aspect-ratio:4/3.6}
.check-list{list-style:none;margin:20px 0 26px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.check-list li{font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)}
.check-list li::before{content:"✓ ";color:var(--pink);font-weight:800}
.steps{list-style:none;counter-reset:step;display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
.steps li{counter-increment:step;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px;font-size:16px}
.steps li::before{content:"Step " counter(step) " — ";font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;color:var(--pink)}
.themes{margin-top:44px}
.themes h3{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:16px}
.themes-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.themes-grid button{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--line);color:var(--purple);font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:999px;min-height:48px}
.themes-grid button:hover{border-color:var(--pink)}
@media(max-width:820px){.bday-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}}

/* PLAYGROUND */
.playground{background:var(--sun)}
.palette{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:8px 0 30px}
.pot{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(60,30,0,.18)}
.pot.sel{outline:4px solid var(--purple)}
.shapes-row{display:flex;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start}
.shapeitem{text-align:center}
.shapeitem svg{width:clamp(110px,16vw,170px);height:auto;cursor:pointer}
.shapeitem small{display:block;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:19px;color:#B03A72;margin-top:6px}
.pg-btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:32px}
.pg-btns button{border:none;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;padding:15px 28px;border-radius:999px;min-height:56px}
#celebrateBtn{background:var(--pink);color:#fff}
#resetArt{background:var(--purple);color:#fff}
#artMsg{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:21px;color:#C22573;margin-top:18px;min-height:30px}

/* FIND US */
.findus{background:#fff}
.fu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:36px}
.fu-item{border-top:4px solid #FFD6E8;padding-top:20px}
.fu-item .idx{color:var(--pink);font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.fu-item h3{font-size:25px;margin:8px 0}
.fu-item p{color:var(--dim);font-size:16px}
.fu-item p b{color:var(--purple)}
@media(max-width:820px){.fu-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}}

/* FOOTER — plain background, no photo overlay */
footer{background:var(--lav);padding:64px 0 0;text-align:center}
footer .ftr-logo{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 auto 18px}
footer h2{font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,54px);margin-bottom:10px}
footer p{color:var(--dim);max-width:520px;margin:0 auto 8px}
footer .founder{color:var(--purple);font-weight:800}
.legalbar{margin-top:48px;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:16px 24px;text-align:left}
.legalbar b{color:var(--purple)}
#fx{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:80}
.balloon{position:fixed;bottom:-90px;z-index:55;font-size:40px;pointer-events:none;animation:balloonUp linear forwards}
@keyframes balloonUp{0%{transform:translateY(0)}100%{transform:translateY(-112vh)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}.reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="top">

<!-- HERO -->
<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="hero-top">
      <div class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Little Bloom Kit logo"><span>Little Bloom Kit</span></div>
      <nav>
        <a href="#kits">Kits</a>
        <a href="#playzone">Play Zone</a>
        <a href="#birthdays">Birthdays</a>
        <a href="#find">Find Us</a>
      </nav>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-grid">
      <div class="hero-text">
        <h1>Little Bloom Kit</h1>
        <p class="tagline">Paint, Create, Bloom</p>
        <p>Paint-your-own plaster kits and birthday activity parties for little artists aged 3–6. Small hands, big imaginations — every kit packed by hand, with all materials provided.</p>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#kits">See the Kits</a>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#playzone">Play Games</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Little Bloom Kit backdrop with paints, brushes, moulds and plaster figures laid out on a woven mat"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="strip" aria-hidden="true"><div class="track" id="strip1"></div></div>

<!-- INTRO -->
<section class="intro-sec">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <h2>More Than a Kit</h2>
      <p>Little Bloom Kit is painting, creating and blooming for small hands — plaster figures, bright paints and brushes, packed by hand and brought to birthdays, playdates and quiet afternoons.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="stats reveal">
      <div><strong>6</strong><span>paint colours in every kit</span></div>
      <div><strong>20+</strong><span>shapes to choose from</span></div>
      <div><strong>100%</strong><span>materials provided</span></div>
      <div><strong>3–6</strong><span>perfect ages</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PICKS -->
<section class="picks-sec">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <h2>Picks in Focus</h2>
      <p>A real Little Bloom party table — kits, brushes, plaster figures and activity cards, all set up and ready to paint.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="photo reveal"><img src="data:image/png;base64,
